description: Cross-language conformance for the LT5 LIVE ranking profile (rank_for(live kind) = the frozen base rank() + an integer stream-health post-pass). A live stream has no resolution tier / seeders / size, so health is scored on the fields it does carry: measured UPTIME (permille 0..=1000 -> 0..=400 human-points, linear), video BITRATE (floor(log2 kbps) above 256, +50 per doubling, cap 300), and audio LANGUAGE-match (owned by the base's +/-500 term, counted once). The whole health band (<= 700 human-points = 700000 milli) stays below the 15000 resolution-tier step. FAIL-OPEN: an absent field contributes 0. The VIDEO profile is unaffected (rank_for(movie) == rank(), asserted per case). Scores are integer milli-points; a port must reproduce them byte-for-byte.
